digest.component_or_area: src/rebar codebase-wide comment and documentation audit
propositions: Six subsystem shards audited 439 files in src/rebar and triaged ~2,033 recoverable comment lines against a destination taxonomy (history→tickets, architecture→ADRs, logic→code, contracts→schema).

Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line module cap at 28 reconciler sites consumed the budget it was documenting; relocating these and verified-stale comments recovered net ~85 lines across six shards (output measured, not a fixed target).

Three files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) retain load-bearing replay-compat and security invariants that cannot be relocated; their do_not_move blocks were recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md.

Verified-stale comments identified (six sites misstate deterministic floor as P1-P9 vs P1-P11, three cite relic Anthropic constraints, import-side comments cite nonexistent future work) were corrected in place where they document live invariants.
Eight locations restated the same idempotent-transform argument (~4 paragraphs each warning against diff non-convergence), consolidated into proposed ADRs 0062-0069 and collapsed to citations.

All six shards landed in dependency order (changes 1542–1547) with CI verified; ADRs 0062–0069 committed before citing comments were collapsed; no behavior change, full test suite and lint/typecheck pass unchanged.
